title: PersonaSource interface + MockPersonaSource fixture adapter
acceptance: packages/personas/src/sources/persona-source.ts exports PersonaSource interface (id, kind, search, sample, getById)
packages/personas/src/sources/mock-source.ts: MockPersonaSource serving >=5 fixture personas with ids prefixed `mock_`
Mock fixtures cover diverse demographics (age 20-65, mixed sex/region/occupation) so unit tests of higher layers have variety
Mock personas explicitly declare source.provider='mock' to satisfy the AGENTS.md provenance rule
Tests: search returns by textQuery substring; sample respects sampleSize; getById returns null for unknown id
